text: Completed 12 cycles of adjuvant FOLFOX + Bevacizumab. Final CEA: 2.8 ng/mL (normal range). Surveillance CT abdomen/pelvis shows no evidence of disease. Patient developed grade 2-3 persistent peripheral neuropathy from oxaliplatin, expected to gradually improve over 6-12 months. Currently off active treatment, entering surveillance phase. Plan: CEA and CT scans every 3 months for first 2 years, then every 6 months. Colonoscopy in 1 year. Patient counseled on symptoms to watch for. Prognosis: Cautiously optimistic given complete surgical resection and good response to chemotherapy, though remains at high risk for recurrence given initial stage IV presentation. ECOG 0-1. Patient doing well overall, returning to normal activities.
